subject: Bluebridge pilot pricing + throughput check-in (dedicated GPUs)
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia@bluebridge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-07T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up & tailored numbers from today's call

Thanks again for the time today — quick recap and the concrete numbers we promised so your team can align on budget/procurement. I kept this focused on the dedicated pilot scenario we discussed (private tenant, reserved lanes). Key items: 

- Current target volume (as discussed): ~750M tokens / month during initial pilot window (with burstable spikes up to ~1.1B tokens/month in peak weeks).
- Throughput objective: steady-state ~300 tokens/sec average, with headroom for 800–1,000 tokens/sec bursts depending on profile.
- Two reasonable hardware paths we recommend: 
  * 1x H100 (reserved lane): best single-GPU headroom for latency-sensitive requests and long-context inference. Estimated sustained throughput ~800–1,000 tok/sec for your model family.
  * 2x A100-80GB (reserved lanes): more predictable cost at sustained ~350–500 tok/sec per GPU depending on quantization profile; two GPUs give better parallelism for concurrent streams.

Pricing (draft, subject to contractual terms / commitment discount):
- H100 reserved lane (baseline): $9 / 1M tokens
- A100-80GB reserved lane (baseline): $7 / 1M tokens
- Volume discount: 15% off baseline above 500M tokens/month; additional tiered rebates for multi-quarter commits.

What this means for Bluebridge's target 750M tokens/mo: baseline cost estimate = $7–9 * 750 = $5,250–$6,750 before the 15% discount. With the 15% commitment tier, net target range moves into ~$4,460–$5,740 / month.

Next steps I suggest: 
1) Confirm preferred hardware lane (H100 vs A100) and whether you prefer a single-lane H100 or 2x A100 configuration for the pilot.
2) Procurement asks — payment terms, SOC2 evidence, and any required PO cadence. Procurement contact copied if helpful.
3) If you confirm hardware preference, I’ll send a revised PDF quote (attached is a starting draft) and a short pilot SOW for sign-off.

Attachment: RBW-Bluebridge-dedicated-quote-v1.pdf (pricing table + lane definitions).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call tomorrow if that helps.

— Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0176

From: Sofia Martinez <sofia@bluebridge.ai>

Subject: Re: Follow-up & tailored numbers from today's call

Thanks, Stephanie — super helpful breakdown. A few quick clarifying points from our side: 

- Budget band: our initial pilot budget is $5k–$12k / month depending on final unit pricing and whether we lean H100 or A100. We’re inclined to aim for ~$8 / 1M tokens as a target to keep ops predictable.
- Volume confirmation: 750M/mo is our conservative baseline; we plan to scale to ~1B tokens/mo within 2–3 months if perf holds.
- Procurement note: we need SOC 2 Type II report and invoice-level billing with monthly breakout by lane/model. Also can you confirm if Redwood supports net-30 on enterprise contracts or requires net-15 for pilot?

If you can incorporate the SOC2 reference and a net-30 option in the revised quote, we can push this through a fast-track approval. Also want to include Ben (cc'd) for any perf/benchmark detail.

Sofia Martinez

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia@bluebridge.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-07T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & tailored numbers from today's call

Hi Sofia — quick technical clarification and a conservative sizing suggestion.

On hardware/throughput: 
- H100 lane: we measure ~850–1,000 tok/sec for models similar to yours at default fp16/qlmin quantization; latency percentile improves for single-stream low-latency traffic.
- A100-80GB lane: ~400–600 tok/sec depending on batch size and KV cache behavior; good for high concurrent request patterns and multi-model workloads.

Sizing guidance for 750M tokens/mo target: average throughput requirement ~300 tok/sec. If you want ~2x headroom for peaks and rolling upgrades, two lanes makes sense: either (a) 1x H100 + 1x A100 or (b) 2x A100. Option (a) gives lower-latency tail performance; option (b) is slightly cheaper at scale.

Unit economics nuance: our per-1M token prices above assume typical caching and batching. If you adopt aggressive prefix caching for repeated contexts, your effective $/1M can drop another ~10–20% without changing lanes. We can model that in the quote if you share a small sample of typical prompt length and repetition patterns.

On billing/terms: we support net-30 on enterprise pilots with an approved PO (we'll include SOC 2 Type II attestation and monthly invoice breakdown in the follow-up packet).

I’ll add a short appendix to the quote that shows cost scenarios for: 500M, 750M, 1B tokens/mo across both hardware paths so you can see marginal $/1M as volume steps.

— Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

From: Sofia Martinez <sofia@bluebridge.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-08T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & tailored numbers from today's call

Appreciate the fast follow-up, both. This is aligned with internal expectations — we want to pursue a pilot and prioritize the H100 + A100 combo you suggested (option a). Please: 

- Send an updated quote that includes the SOC 2 attestation, net-30 terms, and the appendix Ben mentioned (500M / 750M / 1B scenarios).
- Draft SOW with a 3-month pilot window and clear acceptance criteria (latency p95 target, token cap, and a review at month-end 2).
- Can procurement expect a single combined invoice for both lanes, broken out by lane and model? That format will make accounting happy.

If you can get a revised quote + SOW over by EOD our time tomorrow (9/09), we’ll try to return a signed PO by Friday.

Thanks — will loop in procurement directly after we have the SOW.

Sofia
